name: Annelieke Vermeer
bio:
Annelieke's journey into motorsport started with a childhood fascination for the intricate workings of her grandfather's vintage motorcycle. This led to a degree in Mechanical Engineering and several years honing her skills in precision machining for aerospace applications. However, the allure of roaring engines and the relentless pursuit of speed drew her to Formula racing. She thrives on the challenge of pushing the limits of material science and finding that crucial extra tenth of a second through meticulously crafted components.

Her approach as a machinist is characterized by an unwavering commitment to quality and a relentless pursuit of perfection. Annelieke believes that a single micron of error can be the difference between victory and defeat. While not a natural 'team player', she is fiercely independent and exceptionally reliable, often working late into the night to ensure every part meets her exacting standards. What distinguishes Annelieke is her intuitive understanding of material behavior under extreme stress, allowing her to anticipate potential failures and proactively implement solutions.

physical.hairStyle: Neatly braided and pulled back into a bun
physical.description: Annelieke is of average height with a serious, focused demeanor.

quirks: Always wears noise-canceling headphones, even when the machinery is off.
Keeps a small collection of vintage watch parts on her workbench.
Refuses to drink coffee, preferring strong herbal tea instead.
